features.name: Unused variable detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Unused function detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Unused imports detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Unused parameters detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Unused classes detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Unused constants detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Duplicate declaration detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Duplicate import detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Duplicate code detection
features.notes: Exact normalized function bodies are compared within and across project files; near-duplicate detection remains out of scope.

features.name: Dead code detection
features.notes: The analyzer reports unused local bindings and compiler-proven unreachable statements. Whole-file reachability and cross-module dead-code removal are not implemented.

features.name: Unreachable code detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Empty function detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Empty block detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Empty catch block detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Redundant statements detection
features.notes: Detects final bare returns and standalone pure array or object literal expressions. VS Code can remove only comment-free pure literal statements; broader redundant-statement analysis is not implemented.

features.name: Redundant conditions detection
features.notes: The analyzer detects constant conditions and repeated stable conditions in else-if chains; broader logical-equivalence analysis is not implemented.

features.name: Unnecessary expressions detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Constant condition detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Unused labels detection
features.notes: Implemented by deterministic TypeScript AST/compiler diagnostics; JS/TS-family scope.

features.name: Unnecessary type declarations detection
features.notes: The analyzer reports redundant primitive annotations on mutable variables initialized from simple numeric, string, boolean, and bigint literals. Public API intent, contextual typing, const literal widening, and non-literal initializers are preserved; no annotations are removed automatically.

features.name: var to let/const suggestions
features.notes: The analyzer suggests let for reassigned or uninitialized var bindings and const when an initialized binding is not reassigned. Suggestions are informational; no automatic rewrite is applied.

features.name: let to const conversion
features.notes: Reports non-reassigned let bindings as suggestions; no source is silently rewritten.

features.name: Template literal conversion
features.notes: The analyzer suggests template literals for TypeScript-confirmed string concatenations containing only primitive typed operands. VS Code offers a fix when every concatenation operand is a primitive literal; other suggestions remain review-only.

features.name: Optional chaining conversion
features.notes: The analyzer suggests optional chaining for nullish comparisons against null around property or element access on the same local variable. Broader control-flow guard forms are not covered, and no source is rewritten.

features.name: Nullish coalescing conversion
features.notes: The analyzer suggests ?? for loose null checks whose retained branch reads the same local variable. This avoids truthiness changes; strict equality patterns and non-local expressions are not covered, and no source is rewritten.

features.name: Boolean expression simplification
features.notes: The analyzer identifies boolean true/false ternaries and VS Code can apply a comment-free boolean-preserving fix; broader boolean algebra simplification is not implemented.

features.name: Redundant ternary simplification
features.notes: Available in the current repository; see scope notes below.

features.name: Nested condition simplification
features.notes: The analyzer reports repeated stable conditions in an else-if chain as a review suggestion. General nested-condition rewriting is not performed.

features.name: Unnecessary else removal
features.notes: Available in the current repository; see scope notes below.

features.name: Duplicate condition elimination
features.notes: The analyzer reports repeated stable conditions in else-if chains. VS Code can remove a directly repeated, comment-free else-if branch while retaining its final else branch; broader branch rewriting is not covered.

features.name: Unnecessary type assertion detection
features.notes: The analyzer reports TypeScript as/type assertions and non-null assertions when the compiler reports the same display type before and after. Broader type-flow analysis and automatic removal are not implemented.

features.name: Redundant parentheses removal
features.notes: The analyzer reports redundant parentheses only around atomic identifiers and literals. It preserves grouped expressions and string literals used as expression statements because those may form directive prologues; no source is rewritten.

features.name: Simplification of mathematical expressions
features.notes: The analyzer identifies constant literal expressions but does not rewrite algebraic identities or perform numeric simplification.

features.name: Constant expression evaluation
features.notes: The analyzer reports literal-only arithmetic, comparisons, short-circuit logical and conditional expressions with their compile-time result without rewriting code. It does not fold variables, enums, macros, or project-specific constants.

features.name: Safe string concatenation simplification
features.notes: The analyzer suggests template literals only when concatenation operands have primitive types. VS Code offers a fix for literal-only concatenations, preserving grouped constant expressions; identifier operands remain review-only.

features.name: Redundant array operation detection
features.notes: Reports an identity-map candidate when its callback returns the same parameter; keeps findings informational because map still creates a new array.

features.name: Unnecessary object property detection
features.notes: The analyzer suggests shorthand for matching identifier keys and values, excluding __proto__. VS Code offers a quick fix when no comment separates the key and value.

features.name: Unnecessary spread operation detection
features.notes: The analyzer flags empty array/object literal spreads as review suggestions. VS Code removes a comment-free empty spread when it is the only array element or object property; other spread redundancy cases are not analyzed.

features.name: Redundant return detection
features.notes: Available in the current repository; see scope notes below.

features.name: Unnecessary async/await detection
features.notes: The analyzer reports direct return await in async functions when no surrounding try/catch/finally is present; async generators and control-flow cases needing special handling are skipped.

features.name: Automatic import sorting
features.notes: The analyzer reports consecutive type-only imports out of lexical order, and VS Code offers a quick fix for comment-free runs. Value and side-effect imports are never reordered.

features.name: Import grouping
features.notes: Reports missing blank lines at top-level import boundaries across built-in, package, alias, and relative groups. VS Code offers a comment-free fix that inserts a blank line without changing import order.

features.name: Duplicate import merging
features.notes: The analyzer reports duplicate module imports for review; it does not merge import declarations.

features.name: Unused import removal
features.notes: The analyzer detects unused imports with compiler symbols; automatic removal is not implemented.

features.name: Import path normalization
features.notes: Flags relative paths with interior dot or empty segments for review; resolver and symlink behavior prevent automatic normalization.

features.name: Relative import consistency
features.notes: Reports mixed extensionful and extensionless relative import styles in one file; leaves paths unchanged because TypeScript resolution may depend on them.

features.name: Circular dependency detection
features.notes: Tarjan strongly connected components find cycles in configured local JS/TS modules.

features.name: Broken import detection
features.notes: Unresolved relative JS/TS imports are reported; package names and alias configuration are outside scope.

features.name: Missing dependency detection
features.notes: The read-only audit compares static JS/TS imports, re-exports, literal require(), and literal import() package names with root npm dependency sections; it ignores Node built-ins, relative imports, common aliases, URL schemes, and the VS Code host API when declared.

features.name: Unused package detection
features.notes: The audit reports candidate direct dependencies absent from scanned JS/TS imports and recognized package-script executables. Config-driven, generated, and dynamic references can be missed, so the result is informational.

features.name: Duplicate dependency detection
features.notes: The read-only audit reports an npm package repeated across root dependency sections.

features.name: Version conflict reporting
features.notes: The read-only audit warns when one npm package has different declared ranges across root dependency sections.

features.name: Import graph visualization
features.notes: graph --format=mermaid emits a deterministic local module graph.

features.name: Dependency tree generation
features.notes: graph emits deterministic tree, Mermaid, or JSON dependency views.

features.name: Package lockfile consistency checks
features.notes: The read-only audit compares package name, version, and root dependency declarations between package.json and package-lock.json and reports malformed or orphaned lockfiles.

features.name: Hardcoded API key detection
features.notes: Deterministic credential-name plus literal-value patterns; matched values are never printed.

features.name: Hardcoded password detection
features.notes: Deterministic password-name plus literal-value patterns; placeholder values are ignored.

features.name: Private key pattern detection
features.notes: Detects PEM private-key markers in source literals.

features.name: Suspicious URL detection
features.notes: Detects executable URL schemes and embedded URL credentials.

features.name: Unsafe eval() detection
features.notes: Detects direct eval calls.

features.name: Unsafe dynamic code execution detection
features.notes: Detects Function constructor calls and constructions.

features.name: Dangerous shell command detection
features.notes: Detects dynamic command arguments or shell-enabled options on recognized child_process APIs.

features.name: Insecure HTTP usage detection
features.notes: Detects literal remote HTTP URLs and exempts localhost addresses.

features.name: Weak cryptographic algorithm detection
features.notes: Detects md5 or sha1 arguments to createHash/createHmac calls.

features.name: Insecure random number generation detection
features.notes: Detects Math.random calls; the rule does not infer whether the use is security-sensitive.

features.name: SQL injection pattern detection
features.notes: Detects dynamic first arguments to query, execute, and raw calls.

features.name: XSS-prone code pattern detection
features.notes: Detects innerHTML/outerHTML assignment and dangerouslySetInnerHTML attributes.

features.name: Path traversal pattern detection
features.notes: Detects path.join/resolve with dynamic arguments named like request or file input.

features.name: Unsafe deserialization detection
features.notes: Detects general deserialize/unserialize calls and vm execution methods.

features.name: Insecure file permission detection
features.notes: Detects world-accessible numeric modes for common filesystem operations.

features.name: Cyclomatic complexity measurement
features.notes: The metrics report provides per-function and per-file cyclomatic complexity; the analyzer also reports functions above 10 and files above 100.

features.name: Cognitive complexity measurement
features.notes: The metrics report provides per-function and project cognitive complexity using deterministic branch and nesting weights; the analyzer reports functions above 15.

features.name: Function length measurement
features.notes: The metrics report lists each function's source-line span; the analyzer reports functions above 50 lines.

features.name: Class length measurement
features.notes: The metrics report lists class source-line spans; the analyzer reports classes above 100 lines.

features.name: Nesting depth measurement
features.notes: The metrics report lists per-function maximum control-flow nesting; the analyzer reports functions above four levels.

features.name: Parameter count measurement
features.notes: The metrics report lists function parameter counts; the analyzer reports functions with more than five parameters.

features.name: Dependency count measurement
features.notes: The metrics report counts distinct static imports, re-exports, and literal require calls per file and project; the analyzer reports files above 20 dependencies.

features.name: File complexity measurement
features.notes: The metrics report sums per-function cyclomatic complexity by file and across the project; the analyzer reports files above 100.

features.name: Code duplication percentage
features.notes: The metrics report calculates percentages for exact repeated block-bodied functions with at least four statements in the same file; cross-file and near-duplicate matching remain out of scope.

features.name: Maintainability index calculation
features.notes: The metrics report provides a deterministic 0–100 classic Maintainability Index approximation from AST-based Halstead volume, cyclomatic complexity, and source lines, and documents its formula.

features.name: Function relationship mapping
features.notes: The metrics API records per-function syntactic call references and exposes an intra-file call graph. Calls are not fully resolved across files or dynamic dispatch.

features.name: Class relationship mapping
features.notes: The metrics API reports class extends/implements clauses and method names from syntax. It does not resolve transitive relationships across modules.

features.name: Module dependency mapping
features.notes: The graph API and CLI map configured local import/export/require relationships.

features.name: Circular reference analysis
features.notes: Duplicate capability of #67 (circular dependency detection); keep one dependency-graph engine.

features.name: Call graph generation
features.notes: graph --format=callgraph emits Mermaid edges for uniquely named intra-file identifier calls; dynamic, ambiguous, and cross-file calls are omitted.

features.name: Control flow graph generation
features.notes: The metrics graph builds deterministic JavaScript and TypeScript nodes and edges for branches, loops, switch cases, returns, throws, and basic try/catch flow; exceptions and some labeled transfers remain approximate.

features.name: Data flow analysis
features.notes: The TypeScript checker tracks local symbol reads and writes for unused-binding and prefer-const findings. Full interprocedural data-flow graphs are not generated.

features.name: Variable scope analysis
features.notes: Compiler symbol scopes support duplicate-declaration and unused-binding analysis. Cleanser does not expose a standalone scope tree.

features.name: Variable lifetime analysis
features.notes: Metrics report declaration-to-last-reference source spans for parameters and locals; shadowing and runtime closure lifetimes are approximate and clearly described in the report algorithm.

features.name: Export/import relationship analysis
features.notes: Static import and export relationships are represented as graph edges.

features.name: Empty file detection
features.notes: Read-only project audit detects zero-byte regular files.

features.name: Empty folder detection
features.notes: Read-only project audit reports empty directories outside skipped paths.

features.name: Unused file detection
features.notes: Audit reports JavaScript/TypeScript modules unreachable from resolvable package entrypoints; dynamic imports, framework conventions, direct script usage, and non-JS assets are not inferred, so findings are informational candidates only.

features.name: Duplicate file detection
features.notes: Read-only project audit groups same-extension files by byte size and SHA-256; it reports exact content matches only.

features.name: Unused asset detection
features.notes: Read-only project audit scans bounded JavaScript, TypeScript, markup, style, JSON, YAML, and documentation references for common image, audio, video, font, and PDF assets. Unreferenced assets are informational candidates only; dynamic paths and generated references may be missed, and no files are deleted.

features.name: Orphaned configuration detection
features.notes: Read-only audit reports root tsconfig.json or jsconfig.json as informational candidates only when matching sources, recognized TypeScript tools, and (for TypeScript) project references are absent. Editor-only, generated, and external-tool usage cannot be inferred.

features.name: Temporary file detection
features.notes: Read-only project audit detects common editor and temporary-file suffixes.

features.name: Backup file detection
features.notes: Read-only project audit detects backup suffixes and files under .cleanser-backups/.

features.name: Build artifact detection
features.notes: Read-only project audit reports common build output directories and does not traverse them.

features.name: Unnecessary log file detection
features.notes: Read-only project audit detects .log files.

features.name: Unused test file detection
features.notes: The read-only audit reports JS/TS files named *.test.*, *.spec.*, or under __tests__ when no common test or suite call is present. Dynamic test registration and other language runners are not detected.

features.name: Missing .gitignore entry detection
features.notes: Audit reports missing ignore patterns for existing generated directories.

features.name: Duplicate configuration detection
features.notes: Audit compares recognized configuration files by filename and SHA-256 content.

features.name: Project structure analysis
features.notes: Audit reports file count, directory count, byte total, and extension counts.

features.name: Workspace cleanup
features.notes: Audit lists cleanup candidates without deleting them; interactive cleanup and approval are not implemented.

features.name: Missing documentation detection
features.notes: JSDoc coverage checks exported functions, classes, interfaces, type aliases, enums, and variables; other declaration forms and languages remain outside scope.

features.name: Missing function description detection
features.notes: Exported function, method, and class descriptions are checked through the missing-function-documentation rule.

features.name: Missing parameter documentation detection
features.notes: Documented public functions are checked for missing @param tags on named parameters.

features.name: Missing return documentation detection
features.notes: Documented public functions that return a value are checked for @returns tags.

features.name: Invalid JSDoc detection
features.notes: Public function JSDoc checks flag duplicate @param tags and names that do not match parameters; coverage also reports missing descriptions, parameter tags, and return tags. Other invalid-tag and declaration forms are not validated.

features.name: Outdated TODO detection
features.notes: Explicit TODO due dates in [due: YYYY-MM-DD] form are reported after the date passes.

features.name: FIXME tracking
features.notes: FIXME comments are reported with source locations.

features.name: Duplicate comment detection
features.notes: Repeated substantive comments are detected within each JS/TS file; short and license comments are excluded.

features.name: Empty comment detection
features.notes: Empty JS/TS comments are reported with source locations.

features.name: Commented-out code detection
features.notes: Conservative syntax-shaped comment patterns flag likely disabled code; this heuristic can miss or misclassify prose.

features.name: Documentation link validation
features.notes: Partial: local Markdown links are checked offline; remote URLs are not requested or validated.

features.name: Broken internal reference detection
features.notes: Missing local Markdown targets and heading references in linked Markdown documents are reported.

features.name: Markdown formatting
features.notes: Prettier formats Markdown files included by the project configuration.

features.name: Markdown heading consistency
features.notes: ATX and Setext headings are checked for level jumps; generated heading semantics are not fully modeled.

features.name: Documentation coverage reporting
features.notes: Partial: project audit reports Markdown document, heading, and local-link counts.

features.name: Changed-file detection
features.notes: Git status/change inspection lists unstaged, staged, and untracked files.

features.name: Staged-file detection
features.notes: Git changed --staged lists index changes using NUL-safe Git paths.

features.name: Changed-line detection
features.notes: Git lines reports added-line ranges for staged or unstaged diffs.

features.name: Git branch comparison
features.notes: Git compare <revision> reports the three-dot branch comparison against HEAD.

features.name: Dirty working-tree protection
features.notes: Write operations can require a clean Git worktree and reject modified or untracked paths; clean supports the explicit --allow-dirty override.

features.name: Automatic snapshots
features.notes: Partial: formatter creates a first-original backup per file; versioned per-run snapshots are not stored.

features.name: Safe rollback
features.notes: restore <file> --yes atomically restores a safe, regular project file from its Cleanser backup.

features.name: Cleanup history
features.notes: Partial: history lists original formatter backups; it is not a timestamped multi-run history.

features.name: Git blame integration
features.notes: Git blame <file> uses the local Git repository and a validated project-relative path.

features.name: Dedicated cleanup commits
features.notes: clean --commit creates a dedicated --only commit for tracked Cleanser-formatted files after requiring a clean Git tree; unrelated paths are guarded and backups are never committed.

features.name: Pre-commit hooks
features.notes: cleanser hooks install pre-commit adds a managed, read-only check --changed hook; uninstall removes only a Cleanser-managed hook.

features.name: Pre-push hooks
features.notes: cleanser hooks install pre-push adds a managed, read-only full-project check hook; uninstall removes only a Cleanser-managed hook.

features.name: Git diff reports
features.notes: Git diff emits a local, no-color tracked-file diff without invoking external diff or text-conversion tools.

features.name: Conflict detection
features.notes: Git conflicts lists paths in unresolved index-conflict state.

features.name: Protected-file rules
features.notes: Project-relative safety.protected_paths globs can protect individual files and directory trees from cleanup; default exclusions protect dependency, Git, and backup paths.

features.name: Syntax validation
features.notes: TypeScript parsing reports syntax errors in supported JS/TS module files without editing source.

features.name: AST equivalence verification
features.notes: Before formatting writes, Cleanser compares normalized parser ASTs from Prettier's selected parser. Node location and raw formatting metadata are ignored; code and comment structure remain part of the comparison. A mismatch blocks the full write batch.

features.name: Type checking integration
features.notes: The read-only typecheck command uses the TypeScript project config, reports deterministic compiler diagnostics, forces noEmit, and supports JSON output. Project-reference build orchestration and non-TypeScript compiler integrations are not implemented.

features.name: Compiler output comparison
features.notes: Optional verify --compiler compares TypeScript-emitted JavaScript syntax trees for JS/TS files without running code; it does not resolve project dependencies or run a full compiler build.

features.name: Unit test execution
features.notes: The npm test command discovers and runs the Node.js unit suite and then performs syntax checks on the CLI and VS Code extension.

features.name: Integration test execution
features.notes: The Node.js test suite includes CLI, project workflow, configuration, watcher, and VS Code packaging integration coverage.

features.name: Regression test execution
features.notes: Regression cases run with npm test, but no separate baseline or historical snapshot regression runner is provided.

features.name: Formatting verification
features.notes: check verifies whether configured files already match Prettier output without writing them.

features.name: Transformation verification
features.notes: All changed formatter output is AST-verified before backups or writes; the same check is exposed in read-only previews. No semantic refactoring is automatically applied.

features.name: Before/after comparison
features.notes: preview emits deterministic line-based before/after diffs without writing files.

features.name: Automatic rollback on failure
features.notes: Formatting and safety checks complete before writes; if a later atomic replacement fails, Cleanser restores earlier writes from the in-memory originals and retains the original backups.

features.name: Test coverage reporting
features.notes: npm run test:coverage uses Node.js built-in test coverage reporting for the complete discovered test suite.

features.name: Test discovery
features.notes: Node.js test runner discovery executes the repository's tests/*.test.js files through npm test and npm run test:coverage.

features.name: Snapshot testing
features.notes: The snapshot command stores SHA-256 digests of formatted project files, checks for added/removed/changed outputs, and updates only through an explicit --update option.

features.name: Deterministic output verification
features.notes: The read-only verify command formats each configured file twice in memory and reports deterministic output, mismatches, and parser errors in text or JSON.

features.name: Dry-run mode
features.notes: Read-only check and analyze commands provide preview-like validation without writes.

features.name: Diff preview
features.notes: preview shows unified formatting diffs without writes; large files use a bounded full-file diff fallback.

features.name: Interactive approval
features.notes: clean --interactive asks for approval for every changed file; a missing or non-yes answer declines the change. Piped answers support deterministic scripts.

features.name: Per-file approval
features.notes: Interactive approvals apply independently per file. Declined files are not backed up or written; approved files retain transactional rollback protections.

features.name: Per-rule approval
features.notes: VS Code exposes low-risk fixes as individually accepted quick-fix actions, and analysis rules support per-rule severity overrides; a persisted approval policy for every rule is not included.

features.name: Risk classification
features.notes: Deterministic change-risk labels classify AST-equivalent formatting as SAFE, unverified changes as LOW, and semantic, destructive, or AST-mismatched changes as REVIEW.

features.name: Confidence classification
features.notes: Confidence is HIGH when a parser comparison resolves equivalence, MEDIUM when no equivalence result is supplied, and LOW when the parser is unavailable. Interactive prompts include both risk and confidence.

features.name: Backup creation
features.notes: Backups are created before formatter writes when configured.

features.name: Transactional file writes
features.notes: Cleanser preflights all files, creates required backups before replacement, applies atomic replacements under a project lock, and attempts rollback if a batch write fails.

features.name: Atomic replacement
features.notes: Changed files are replaced atomically after formatting succeeds.

features.name: File locking
features.notes: Write runs acquire an exclusive .cleanser.lock file and release it after completion; existing locks stop overlapping Cleanser write runs with owner details when available.

features.name: Symlink protection
features.notes: Symlinked files and directories are skipped by project scanning.

features.name: Path traversal protection
features.notes: Project-relative paths and backup paths are checked against traversal.

features.name: File integrity verification
features.notes: Partial: Cleanser verifies the source is still a safe regular file and unchanged before replacing it; durable hash manifests are not stored.

features.name: Undo and redo
features.notes: Partial: undo <file> --yes restores the first original backup; redo and multi-step history are not available.

features.name: Crash recovery
features.notes: Atomic replacement prevents partially written individual files, original backups remain available, and a process crash leaves an explicit lock file; automatic transaction journal replay is not implemented.

features.name: Protected directories
features.notes: Configuration safety.protected_paths patterns exclude matching files and directory trees from project cleanup; node_modules, .git, and Cleanser backups remain protected by default.

features.name: Maximum-change limits
features.notes: Configurable safety.maximum_changed_files and safety.maximum_change_bytes and CLI --max-files/--max-bytes limits reject the full batch before writes when exceeded.

features.name: Read-only mode
features.notes: check and analyze are read-only modes.

features.name: Safe mode and aggressive mode
features.notes: Partial: safe mode is enforced and aggressive mode is explicitly rejected.

features.name: JavaScript
features.notes: JavaScript formatting and AST analysis are supported.

features.name: TypeScript
features.notes: TypeScript formatting and AST analysis are supported.

features.name: JSX
features.notes: JSX formatting and AST analysis are supported.

features.name: TSX
features.notes: TSX formatting and AST analysis are supported.

features.name: Python
features.notes: Not implemented yet.

features.name: C
features.notes: Not implemented yet.

features.name: C++
features.notes: Not implemented yet.

features.name: Rust
features.notes: Not implemented yet.

features.name: Java

features.name: .cleanser.clns configuration
features.notes: Strict YAML-based .cleanser.clns configuration is supported.

features.name: JSON configuration support
features.notes: Cleanser accepts strict .cleanser.json alongside .cleanser.clns, rejects duplicate JSON keys and ambiguous dual config files, and prevents init from creating a competing YAML config.

features.name: YAML configuration support
features.notes: The project configuration uses validated YAML syntax.

features.name: Configuration inheritance
features.notes: A config may extend one relative YAML or JSON config inside the project root; inherited sections merge predictably, cycles and traversal are rejected, and nesting is capped.

features.name: Folder-specific configuration
features.notes: Ordered project-relative file-glob overrides apply folder-scoped formatting and analysis settings without requiring scattered nested config files.

features.name: File-specific rules
features.notes: Each ordered file-glob override can set built-in analysis rules to off, info, warning, or error for matching files.

features.name: Rule severity settings
features.notes: Built-in rule severity can be overridden to info, warning, or error.

features.name: Rule enable/disable
features.notes: Built-in analysis rules can be disabled with off in configuration.

features.name: Custom ignore patterns
features.notes: Configurable include/exclude glob patterns select project files.

features.name: Preset configurations
features.notes: Built-in recommended, strict, and security presets are applied before per-rule overrides.

features.name: Configuration validation
features.notes: Configuration schema, types, values, and unknown keys are validated.

features.name: Configuration migration
features.notes: config migrate converts between .cleanser.clns YAML and .cleanser.json while preserving validated settings and rolling back on validation failure. Schema-version migration is not available.

features.name: Configuration diagnostics
features.notes: Config loading gives actionable schema, inheritance, path and EditorConfig errors; doctor reports the selected config, override count, supported file count and discovered EditorConfig files. Editor integration and automatic repair suggestions remain.

features.name: Prettier integration
features.notes: Prettier is an installed formatting engine with validated Cleanser options.

features.name: EditorConfig integration
features.notes: Cleanser reads cascading .editorconfig files and honors root, common glob sections, indentation, line endings, print width and final-newline settings. It does not trim whitespace inside string data; charset conversion and numeric brace ranges are not supported.

features.name: ESLint integration
features.notes: cleanser eslint runs the ESLint API installed in the current project, renders deterministic text or JSON findings, and never installs dependencies or modifies files.

features.name: Shared team configuration
features.notes: Projects can safely extend a relative configuration file within the project root and layer local overrides. Remote shared packages and team-wide distribution are not implemented.

features.name: clean command
features.notes: Implemented as a local CLI command.

features.name: check command
features.notes: Implemented as a local CLI command.

features.name: format command
features.notes: format is a CLI alias for the safe clean command.

features.name: analyze command
features.notes: Implemented as a local CLI command.

features.name: fix command
features.notes: fix is a CLI alias for safe project formatting.

features.name: undo command
features.notes: undo is a CLI alias for restore and still requires --yes before replacing a file.

features.name: history command
features.notes: Duplicate capability of #148 (cleanup history); expose one history service through CLI.

features.name: init command
features.notes: Implemented as a local CLI command.

features.name: doctor command
features.notes: doctor checks supported Node.js version, effective configuration, supported file count, overrides, and discovered EditorConfig files.

features.name: report command
features.notes: report emits deterministic Markdown, JSON, CSV, HTML, and SARIF findings.

features.name: watch command
features.notes: watch polls included-file metadata, formats only changed files with backups, and supports read-only --check mode.

features.name: explain command
features.notes: explain <rule-id> prints a built-in rule severity and explanation.

features.name: config command
features.notes: config prints the validated effective configuration as JSON; editing and migrations are not included.

features.name: rules command
features.notes: Implemented as a local CLI command.

features.name: version command
features.notes: Implemented as a local CLI command.

features.name: Progress indicators
features.notes: Clean and check report deterministic per-file progress to terminal integrations and show a live count only when stdout is a terminal; quiet mode and redirected output stay clean.

features.name: Color-coded output
features.notes: CLI status output uses terminal colors when stdout is a terminal, FORCE_COLOR is set, or color is explicitly available; NO_COLOR and FORCE_COLOR=0 disable ANSI styling. Structured reports remain uncolored.

features.name: Interactive terminal UI
features.notes: The clean command provides per-file interactive approval and safely declines when input closes. A richer full-screen terminal interface is not included.

features.name: JSON output
features.notes: Stable JSON output is implemented for analyzer findings.

features.name: Quiet mode
features.notes: clean and check support --quiet while preserving diagnostics and exit codes; watch can hide routine messages.

features.name: Verbose mode
features.notes: clean, check, and preview accept --verbose and include risk, confidence, and parser verification details. --quiet and --verbose are mutually exclusive where supported.

features.name: VS Code extension
features.notes: VS Code formatting integration supports JS/JSX/TS/TSX, HTML, CSS, SCSS, JSON, JSONC, YAML, Markdown, and Vue.

features.name: Format on save
features.notes: VS Code formats supported files on save when configured with trigger: onSave.

features.name: Clean on save
features.notes: VS Code save events run configured formatting and schedule supported JS/TS analysis. Analysis reports diagnostics without rewriting semantic code; formatting is guarded by source-equivalence verification and backups.

features.name: Quick fixes
features.notes: VS Code offers safe fixes for object shorthand, redundant atomic parentheses, pure literal statements, empty spreads, boolean ternaries, literal concatenations, repeated else-if branches, import grouping, and consecutive type-only import ordering; other findings remain explanation-only.

features.name: Code actions
features.notes: VS Code exposes safe quick fixes for supported diagnostics and explanation actions for analyzer findings. Other diagnostics remain explanation-only.

features.name: Inline diagnostics
features.notes: Analyzer findings appear as VS Code diagnostics after a supported JS/TS document is saved.

features.name: Rule explanations
features.notes: The CLI and VS Code diagnostic action share built-in rule descriptions; VS Code uses the current document's effective per-file severity, including for unsaved buffers.

features.name: Diff preview
features.notes: VS Code provides a read-only side-by-side diff preview for the current supported file, using the unsaved editor buffer and requiring source-equivalence verification before showing output.

features.name: File-level cleanup
features.notes: VS Code can format a supported current file or apply all current non-overlapping safe analyzer fixes as one undoable edit. Analyzer fixes require the saved JS/TS file to remain unchanged during analysis.

features.name: Selection-level cleanup
features.notes: VS Code and the stdio LSP expose range formatting; edits are checked against full-source AST equivalence.

features.name: Workspace cleanup
features.notes: VS Code exposes a workspace cleanup command that processes every open workspace folder through the backed-up, atomic, source-equivalence-verified Cleanser project formatter. Disabled folders are skipped.

features.name: Keyboard shortcuts
features.notes: VS Code contributes Ctrl+Alt+F (Cmd+Option+F on macOS) for current-file formatting.

features.name: Status bar integration
features.notes: VS Code shows Cleanser status for supported files and exposes current-file formatting from the status bar.

features.name: JetBrains integration
features.notes: Compatible JetBrains, Neovim, and Sublime LSP clients can use the generic stdio formatter; there are no vendor-specific packages or setup wizards.

features.name: Neovim integration
features.notes: Compatible JetBrains, Neovim, and Sublime LSP clients can use the generic stdio formatter; there are no vendor-specific packages or setup wizards.

features.name: Sublime Text integration
features.notes: Compatible JetBrains, Neovim, and Sublime LSP clients can use the generic stdio formatter; there are no vendor-specific packages or setup wizards.

features.name: LSP server
features.notes: cleanser lsp serves stdio JSON-RPC initialization, full document sync, and source-equivalence-checked formatting for included files inside the workspace. Diagnostics, code actions, and multi-root workspaces are not provided.

features.name: GitHub Actions
features.notes: This repository has GitHub Actions for tests/releases; a reusable consumer-facing action is not provided.

features.name: GitLab CI integration
features.notes: cleanser ci init gitlab creates a non-overwriting starter pipeline that installs dependencies, runs npm test, and runs npm run check; it does not operate a GitLab account or publish reports remotely.

features.name: Bitbucket pipeline integration
features.notes: cleanser ci init bitbucket creates a non-overwriting pipeline starter that installs dependencies, runs npm test, and runs npm run check; it does not configure a Bitbucket account or upload reports remotely.

features.name: Pull request reports
features.notes: pr-report --base=REF emits deterministic JSON or Markdown for committed changed paths, formatting debt, and analyzer findings; it does not post to GitHub.

features.name: Pull request annotations
features.notes: Partial: SARIF results include stable rule IDs, severity, and locations; automated PR annotation publishing is not configured.

features.name: CI failure on violations
features.notes: Analyzer and security commands exit non-zero when warning or error findings are present.

features.name: Changed-files-only checks
features.notes: clean, check, analyze, report, security, and preview can limit work to Git changed files.

features.name: Branch comparison
features.notes: Duplicate capability of #144 (branch comparison); share one Git comparison engine.

features.name: PR cleanup summaries
features.notes: pr-report includes changed-file formatting results, verification risk, analyzer severity totals, and per-file findings in deterministic local JSON or Markdown.

features.name: Automatic issue reporting
features.notes: Not implemented yet.

features.name: Machine-readable reports
features.notes: Machine-readable JSON and CSV analyzer reports are available.

features.name: SARIF output for supported findings
features.notes: report --format=sarif emits SARIF 2.1.0 with deterministic rules and file locations.

features.name: Parallel file processing
features.notes: Clean operations prepare files with a bounded concurrency of four while preserving result and progress order; approved atomic writes remain sequential.

features.name: Incremental scanning
features.notes: Partial: analyze, check, clean, report, security, and preview accept --changed; analyzer dependency mapping still scans the project.

features.name: File caching
features.notes: A bounded in-process text cache validates file metadata before serving content and is used by formatting and analysis reads; it is not persisted between runs.

features.name: AST caching
features.notes: Not implemented yet.

features.name: Large-project optimization
features.notes: Formatting work runs with a bounded four-file concurrency pool and supports file/byte batch caps; analyzer-wide large-project scheduling is not yet implemented.

features.name: Memory usage optimization
features.notes: Formatting concurrency and the bounded diff matrix avoid unbounded per-file diff memory growth; complete streaming and analysis memory profiling are not included.

features.name: Streaming output
features.notes: TTY clean and check operations stream bounded, ordered progress callbacks while files are prepared. Analyzer, metrics, and audit commands still buffer structured findings before rendering.

features.name: Monorepo support
features.notes: Root scans recurse into nested packages and path-based overrides apply per package. Workspace-local configuration and independent package dependency analysis are not resolved.

features.name: Worker-based processing
features.notes: Not implemented yet.

features.name: Cancellation support
features.notes: CLI clean/check and the watcher pass AbortSignals into formatting; cancellation is checked during preparation and writes, and an interrupted batch rolls back earlier replacements. An individual atomic file replacement is allowed to finish before cancellation is observed.

features.name: Resource limits
features.notes: Clean operations support configurable maximum changed-file and changed-byte limits, with CLI overrides. CPU, memory, and time budgets are not enforced.

features.name: Benchmark suite
features.notes: npm run benchmark creates a temporary project, warms the formatter once, measures repeated read-only clean runs, checks stable file counts, and prints run timings plus the median. CLEANSER_BENCH_FILES and CLEANSER_BENCH_RUNS set bounded fixture and sample counts.

features.name: Performance profiling
features.notes: npm run profile captures a V8 CPU profile while running the temporary-project benchmark, writes the .cpuprofile to the operating-system temporary directory, and reports its path with timing data. CLEANSER_BENCH_FILES and CLEANSER_BENCH_RUNS bound the run.

features.name: Code health score
features.notes: The metrics report computes a documented 0–100 proxy: line-weighted average Maintainability Index minus two points per percentage point of exact duplicate lines, clamped to 0–100.

features.name: Cleanup score
features.notes: The read-only score command combines formatting debt and JS/TS analyzer findings using a documented deterministic penalty formula, with JSON and changed-file output.

features.name: Complexity reports
features.notes: The metrics command exports per-file and per-function complexity as text or deterministic JSON, including changed-file scans.

features.name: Duplication reports
features.notes: The metrics command reports exact same-file duplicate function counts, lines, and percentages at file and project level for block-bodied functions with at least four statements; cross-file and near-duplicate detection are excluded.

features.name: Security findings report
features.notes: security produces dedicated Markdown, JSON, CSV, HTML, or SARIF output for built-in security findings.

features.name: HTML reports
features.notes: report --format=html emits a self-contained HTML table and escapes source-controlled report text.

features.name: Markdown reports
features.notes: report emits a Markdown findings table by default or with --format=markdown.

features.name: JSON reports
features.notes: Analyzer findings can be emitted as deterministic JSON.

features.name: CSV reports
features.notes: report --format=csv emits escaped, deterministic CSV findings.

features.name: Historical comparisons
features.notes: Git compare/history/blame commands and pr-report --base=REF provide revision-based and changed-file comparisons; persistent historical trend storage is not included.

features.name: Custom rule API
features.notes: The cleanser/plugin-api export defines validated custom rules and runs them against source text to produce read-only findings. Built-in CLI analyzer registration is not provided.

features.name: Plugin API
features.notes: The public plugin API bundles validated rule descriptors and executes them when explicitly called by project code. Automatic plugin discovery and dependency installation are not provided.

features.name: Plugin dependency management
features.notes: Custom plugin descriptors can declare npm dependencies and compare them against package manifest dependency sections; dependencies are not installed automatically.

features.name: Rule marketplace
features.notes: Not implemented yet.

features.name: Custom language adapters
features.notes: Public defineLanguageAdapter API validates file extensions and requires a semantic verifier; automatic CLI plugin discovery and dependency installation are not included.

features.name: Team presets
features.notes: Uses the same preset registry as #248; shared team rule packs remain a separate planned delivery.

features.name: Shared rule packs
features.notes: A plugin can package multiple custom rules as a shareable JavaScript module through cleanser/plugin-api. A registry, remote distribution, and version manager are not provided.

features.name: Public documentation
features.notes: Partial: user-facing CLI help and package metadata exist; full public and API documentation is absent by request.

features.name: Interactive playground
features.notes: The playground command serves a loopback-only in-memory formatter for JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, JSON, CSS, HTML, YAML, and Markdown with a 1 MB request limit; it is not deployed as a public site.

features.name: Example projects
features.notes: examples/javascript and examples/typescript provide minimal runnable source projects with Cleanser config; examples for all supported formatters and integration scenarios remain to be added.

features.name: API documentation
features.notes: The public plugin API declarations include JSDoc for types and functions; a generated standalone reference site is not included.

features.name: Extension developer SDK
features.notes: A typed plugin API export, runtime validation, type tests, and JavaScript/TypeScript examples form a small developer SDK; language adapters, dependency management, and a packaged guide are not included.

relationships.decision: One circular-dependency analysis implementation; expose findings in any relevant report.
One cleanup-history store/service with CLI and other adapters.
One branch-comparison engine reused by Git and CI.
One preset registry; team presets can be distributed through shared packs.
A common rule explanation catalogue powers CLI and IDE views.
Workspace cleanup engine and IDE invocation remain separate capabilities.
